_note: License registry and source list. build_db.py refuses to package a version whose license.status is not 'confirmed' unless --allow-unverified is passed (dev and sample builds only). Optional fields: "testaments" (default ["OT", "NT"]) lists the testaments a version covers; "book_names": "amh" shows Amharic book names for a version in another language. "bundle": false makes a version a downloadable content pack (build_db.py --packs) instead of part of content.db.

source._verify: Confirm the eBible.org ID for the 1962/1954 E.C. text on https://ebible.org/find/ before the first release build.
